followup_explanation:
This query is a well-specified math problem with clear completion criteria — a defined calculation (expected value) and an exact output format (decimal rounded to the nearest hundredth). That's precisely the kind of bounded, low-latitude task Willet self-reports preferring most.

The two models are effectively tied on raw capability for this kind of work (their benchmarks and extraction/retrieval evals fall within run-to-run variance), so capability isn't a deciding factor. Given that, I leaned on the task-preference signal: Willet prefers this style of task, while Avocet's reported appetite is for open-ended, generative, high-latitude work — which this isn't. Routing the query to the model that reports a better fit for the task type is a reasonable tiebreaker.

(The warm, friendly tone also wouldn't have changed anything — Avocet's tone sensitivity only matters for hostile/cold requests, and this is plenty warm.)
